title: Extension of principal cycles using punctured local line bundles
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian normal scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], and let $T\subseteq|X|$ be any set of points. A codimension-one cycle $D$ means a locally finite formal sum $\sum_i n_i[Z_i]$, with $n_i\in\mathbf Z$ and distinct nonempty irreducible closed subsets $Z_i$ whose generic points $\xi_i$ satisfy $\dim\mathcal O_{X,\xi_i}=1$ [def-weil-irreducible-components, def-sc-generic-point, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Here locally finite means every point has an open neighbourhood meeting only finitely many $Z_i$. For $x\in X$, put $R_x=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $K_x=\operatorname{Frac}(R_x)$. A prime $\mathfrak q\subset R_x$ of height one corresponds to a generization $z_{\mathfrak q}$ of $x$ of local-ring dimension one. The localization $(R_x)_{\mathfrak q}$ is a discrete valuation ring; let $v_{\mathfrak q}:K_x^\times\to\mathbf Z$ denote its normalized valuation [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. Set $n_D(z)=n_i$ when $z=\xi_i$ and $n_D(z)=0$ otherwise. Say $D$ is principal at $x$ if there exists $a_x\in K_x^\times$ with $v_{\mathfrak q}(a_x)=n_D(z_{\mathfrak q})$ for every height-one $\mathfrak q\subset R_x$.
Assume that for every $x\in X$ with $\dim R_x\ge2$ and $\overline{\{x\}}\cap T=\varnothing$, every invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] on the punctured spectrum $\operatorname{Spec}R_x\setminus\{\mathfrak m_x\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-open-immersion] is isomorphic to its structure sheaf, where $\mathfrak m_x$ is the maximal ideal of $R_x$. Then every codimension-one cycle $D$ that is principal at each point of $T$ is principal at every point of $X$. No quasi-compactness, separatedness, integrality of $X$, or constructibility of $T$ is assumed.

source.place: EGA IV4, Corollary 21.13.15, implication (b) implies (a), with parafactoriality expressed by trivial invertible modules on the punctured local spectrum; normal Noetherian local rings of dimension at least 2 already satisfy the required Hartogs condition. Local form of principality is EGA 21.6.10(i). Read online in the English EGA translation; local EGA IV4 WANTED. No Stacks tag states this arbitrary-subset parafactorial extension criterion.

proof.text: Work locally around an arbitrary point. Choose a Noetherian affine neighbourhood $W$ inside a neighbourhood meeting only finitely many of the $Z_i$; this is possible by the assumed local finiteness and [pqf-lem-affine-open-locnoeth]. Normality restricts to opens because their local rings are unchanged. By clause (2) of [rem-pc-regular-normal], the component of $W$ containing the point is an open normal integral scheme. Choose an affine neighbourhood $V=\operatorname{Spec}A$ inside that component. Its coordinate ring is a domain by [def-pc-integral-scheme], and is Noetherian by [pqf-lem-affine-open-locnoeth]. The stalk identification in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-domain-stalks-function-field] identifies every $A_{\mathfrak p}$ with a normal local ring of $X$; [lem-weil-pbc-normal-domain-of-local-normal] therefore makes $A$ a normal domain. These $V$ cover $X$, each meeting only finitely many terms of $D$. Restricting $D$ to $V$ retains precisely the codimension-one generic points lying in $V$; a nonempty open of an irreducible closed set contains its generic point. Thus it gives a finite height-one divisor $D_V$ of $A$.

source.place: Tags 01OW (properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian), 033M (properties-lemma-normal-Noetherian), 033L (properties-lemma-integral-normal), 030B (algebra-lemma-normality-is-local); affine refinement of EGA IV4 21.13.14.

proof.text: On such a $V$, put $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$ and $M=I_A(D_V)\subset K$, using the explicit valuation inequalities of [lem-per-divisorial-fractional-module-lattices]. That node gives a nonzero finite module, its localization at any multiplicative set, its prescribed height-one lattices, and $B=\bigcap_{\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak q=1}B_{\mathfrak q}$ for every Noetherian normal domain $B$. At $x=\mathfrak p\in V$, set $B=A_{\mathfrak p}$. It is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian] and normal with fraction field $K$ by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-normal-domain]. Prime correspondence and equality of iterated local rings in [lem-weil-pbc-localization-prime-residue-field-iso] identify its height-one primes and valuations with the codimension-one generizations in the definition of principality above. Consequently $D$ is principal at $x$ if and only if $M_{\mathfrak p}=aB$ for some $a\in K^\times$: if $v_{\mathfrak q}(a)=n_D(z_{\mathfrak q})$, the inequalities defining $I_B(D_x)$ say $f/a\in\bigcap B_{\mathfrak q}=B$; conversely localizing $aB$ at height one gives $aB_{\mathfrak q}=\pi_{\mathfrak q}^{n_D(z_{\mathfrak q})}B_{\mathfrak q}$, hence the required valuation equality.

source.place: Tag 0EBM, finite embedded fractional-module construction; explicit finite-denominator proof of openness, the closed nonprincipal locus used in EGA IV4 21.13.14.

proof.text: No point of $N$ has local-ring dimension at most one. The local ring is a Noetherian normal local domain: on the charts this follows from [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian] and [lem-weil-pbc-localization-normal-domain]. In dimension zero its maximal ideal is $(0)$, since a nonzero maximal ideal would give the strict prime chain $(0)\subsetneq\mathfrak m$; therefore the ring is a field and there are no height-one primes. The element $1$ represents the empty divisor. In dimension one [lem-sc-normal-dim1-dvr] gives a DVR, whose sole height-one prime is its maximal ideal. A uniformizer to the integer power given by the coefficient of $D$ represents $D$ there, including negative coefficients. Hence every point of $N$ has dimension at least two.

source.place: Tag 00PD (algebra-lemma-characterize-dvr); EGA IV4 21.13.14, observation that the nonprincipal locus has codimension at least two.

proof.text: Suppose $N\ne\varnothing$, and choose one of the integral Noetherian affine charts $V$ meeting $N$. By [lem-sc-noetherian-closed-subset-finite-components], $N\cap V$ is the union of finitely many irreducible components; choose one, $C$. It is closed in $V$ because $N\cap V$ is closed. By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-sober] it has a generic point $\eta$. Every strict generization $z$ of $\eta$ belongs to $V$ and lies outside $N$. To see this, if $z\in N\cap V$, its irreducible closure in $V$ is contained in $N\cap V$ and contains $C=\overline{\{\eta\}}^{V}$; maximality of $C$ makes the closures equal, and uniqueness of the generic point forces $z=\eta$. Furthermore global closedness of $N$ gives $\overline{\{\eta\}}^{X}\subseteq N$, so this closure misses $T$, even if $T$ is not contained in $V$. Step 4 gives $\dim\mathcal O_{X,\eta}\ge2$. These are exactly the two conditions under which the assumed punctured-spectrum triviality applies at $\eta$.

source.place: Tag 0BA8 (properties-lemma-Noetherian-irreducible-components); scheme sobriety; generic-point form of the local obstruction argument behind EGA IV4 21.13.14--15.

proof.text: Write $\mathfrak p$ for $\eta$ on $V=\operatorname{Spec}A$, put $B=A_{\mathfrak p}=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$, and let $U=\operatorname{Spec}B\setminus\{\mathfrak pB\}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism], the points of $U$ map to strict generizations of $\eta$ and their local rings are unchanged. Localize the module of step 2 to $J=M_{\mathfrak p}=I_B(D_\eta)\subset K$. The localization assertion of [lem-per-divisorial-fractional-module-lattices] identifies its further localizations with the divisor modules at those generizations. They are cyclic by step 5 and step 2. Apply the explicit finite-denominator argument of step 3 over $B$ around each point of $U$: $\widetilde J|_U$ is locally free of rank one. The basic-open formula in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] gives quasi-coherence and the trivializations $\widetilde J|_{D(t)}=m\mathcal O_{D(t)}$ whenever $J_t=mB_t$. Thus $L=\widetilde J|_U$ is an invertible module in the sense of [def-sc-invertible-module]. By the hypothesis at $\eta$, choose an isomorphism $\phi:\mathcal O_U\xrightarrow{\sim}L$.

source.place: Tag 0EBM, divisor fractional modules under localization; associated-module basic-open sections; the punctured invertible module in EGA IV4 21.13.14--15.

proof.text: Let $\sigma=\phi(1)\in\Gamma(U,L)$. On every nonempty basic open $D(t)\subseteq U$, the basic-open formula [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] embeds $L(D(t))=J_t$ in $K$, with restriction maps the inclusions in $K$. Every such basic open contains the generic point $(0)$, and the germ of $\sigma$ there is one element $a\in K^\times$; it is nonzero because $J\otimes_B K=K$ and $\phi$ is an isomorphism. Hence on every one of these basic opens the section $\sigma$ is this same $a$. For a height-one prime $\mathfrak q$ of $B$, the inequality $\dim B\ge2$ ensures $\mathfrak q\ne\mathfrak pB$, so $\mathfrak q\in U$. Taking germs (the union of basic-open localizations) gives $J_{\mathfrak q}=aB_{\mathfrak q}$, since $\phi_{\mathfrak q}$ is an isomorphism. The height-one lattice formula of [lem-per-divisorial-fractional-module-lattices] now reads $aB_{\mathfrak q}=\pi_{\mathfrak q}^{n_D(z_{\mathfrak q})}B_{\mathfrak q}$. Thus $v_{\mathfrak q}(a)=n_D(z_{\mathfrak q})$ for every height-one prime. This is precisely principality at $\eta$, contradicting $\eta\in N$. Therefore $N=\varnothing$ and $D$ is principal at every point of $X$.

Step by step: (1) the charts are correct: rem-pc-regular-normal clause (2) applies to a Noetherian affine W, A is a domain by def-pc-integral-scheme and normal by 030B with 01HV, and D restricted to V is finite. (2) The principal-iff-cyclic equivalence is right: localization 00FN/00GY, height-one primes kept under 00E3, and the intersection and lattice clauses of lem-per-divisorial applied to B. (3) The finite-denominator argument shows the principal locus P is open, so N is closed and misses T. (4) Dimension 0 gives a field and dimension 1 gives a DVR (lem-sc-normal-dim1-dvr), so every point of N has dimension at least 2. (5) A component of N∩V (0BA8) has a generic point η (01IS); maximality is checked, and closure_X(η) ⊆ N misses T. (6) J~ on the punctured spectrum is invertible: 01J6 for generizations, the 01HV basic-open formula, and D(t) cannot contain pB because J is not cyclic there. (7) The section σ is a single nonzero element a of K, nonzero because J spans K, and v_q(a)=n_D(z_q) at every height-one q, which contradicts η∈N. Edge cases checked: empty X, D=0, T=X, T=∅, negative coefficients, non-quasi-compact X, and the quadric cone as a negative test.
